method: Deflated Sharpe (Bailey & Lopez de Prado 2014): PSR evaluated at the expected max Sharpe of N null trials. Sharpes are annualized for display; the computation is per-period.

headline_book.psr_note: P(true Sharpe > 0), skew/kurtosis-corrected. Below 0.5 means the point Sharpe cannot even clear zero.

trial_ledger.note: every distinct Sharpe examined across v1 + Phase-2 walk-forward + v2 sweeps. Trials share data (folds/regimes/cadences are cuts of one book), so N over-counts independent trials and the deflation is conservative.

deflated_sharpe.supersedes: the 'deferred, not faked' stub in metrics_spy.json (resolved on Phase-2 Day 38)

interpretation: The pre-registered SPY Sharpe is negative (PSR vs zero = 0.08 < 0.5): it cannot even clear zero. Every standalone configuration tried is also negative (best -1.15). The single most favourable number the whole search produced -- the 'SPY regime low_vol' subset at +2.79 -- is below the deflated bar (+3.07, the Sharpe expected from the luckiest of N=12 null trials), so even the best data-mined slice sits within multiple-testing noise. DSR ~ 0 for every plausible N (6..100). Nothing in the project survives deflation: the disproof is complete and multiple-testing-robust.
